name: New model
description: A test model that selects a courier for sample product orders using customer, destination, delivery, and quantity attributes.

parameters.name: VIP Indicator
parameters.description: Indicates whether the customer qualifies for VIP handling.

parameters.name: Country
parameters.description: Destination country code supplied with the order.

parameters.name: Delivery Type
parameters.description: Requested delivery service, such as standard or scheduled.

parameters.name: Quantity
parameters.description: Number of product units included in the order.

payloads.name: Order Request
payloads.description: Order attributes used to select an appropriate courier service.

events.name: Product X
events.description: Represents an order request for Product X.

events.name: Product Y
events.description: Represents an order request for Product Y.

events.name: Product Z
events.description: Represents an order request for Product Z.

conditions.name: VIP Customer
conditions.description: Matches order requests from VIP customers.

conditions.name: Non-VIP Customer
conditions.description: Matches order requests from customers without VIP status.

conditions.name: Country - US
conditions.description: Matches orders whose destination country is the United States.

conditions.name: Country - UK
conditions.description: Matches orders whose destination country is the United Kingdom.

conditions.name: Country - UAE
conditions.description: Matches orders whose destination country is the United Arab Emirates.

conditions.name: Country - New Zealand
conditions.description: Matches orders whose destination country is New Zealand.

conditions.name: Delivery Type - Standard
conditions.description: Matches orders requesting the standard delivery service.

conditions.name: Delivery Type - Scheduled
conditions.description: Matches orders requesting a delivery scheduled for a selected date or time.

conditions.name: Quantity < 10
conditions.description: Matches orders containing fewer than ten product units.

conditions.name: 10 <= Quantity < 100
conditions.description: Matches orders containing between ten and ninety-nine product units.

actions.name: Courier - Local
actions.description: Selects the local courier for an eligible domestic delivery.

actions.name: Courier - International
actions.description: Selects the international courier for an eligible overseas delivery.

actions.name: Courier - Same Day
actions.description: Selects the same-day courier for an eligible expedited delivery.

rules.name: Local Delivery
rules.description: Routes standard Product X orders through the local courier.

rules.name: Scheduled Delivery
rules.description: Routes scheduled Product X orders through the local courier.
